t: The provisions of this Act shall cease to be effective one year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

fable.w: This section is a sunset clause that only says when the Act stops being effective. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. There is no tempting contrary reading, since nothing in the text is on-topic for participation.

qwen_chat.w: This section simply states the expiration date of the Act. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or comment periods mentioned.

qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the expiration of the Act implies a decision-making process involving the public or other outside entities to renew or terminate it, but the text itself only states a factual condition for the Act's cessation.
